dataset: UCI AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance Dataset (10,000 instances)
intended_use: Decision-support telemetry monitoring for Industry 4.0 milling machines to identify impending mechanical, thermal, and electrical failures before catastrophic breakdown.
out_of_scope_use: Autonomous equipment shutdown without human technician verification, or deployment on non-rotational industrial equipment differing from milling machine dynamics.
explanation_methods: SHAP TreeExplainer (Global summary beeswarm and local Shapley attribution waterfall)
LIME Tabular Explainer (Sparse local linear decision rules)
Partial Dependence Plots (1D response curves for torque, wear, speed, temp)
Counterfactual What-If Simulation (Sensitivity analysis for operating adjustments)
Multi-Modal NLP LIME Token Attribution (Technician shift notes urgency classifier)
Spatial Saliency Defect Localization (Demonstrative tool crack, bearing spalling, and stator thermal inspection)

fairness_findings.group_variable: Product Quality Variant (type: L, M, H)
fairness_findings.disparate_impact_assessment: False positive rates remain below 1.5% across all variants. Lower F1 on variant H is driven by low sample support (20% of dataset with only 21 failure cases in test set).

leakage_findings.conclusion: AutoML naively capitalizes on post-failure documentation. Model governance and XAI auditing are strictly required to filter downstream status flags before deployment.

known_limitations: Moderate recall (0.5588) under default 0.50 threshold due to severe 3.39% class imbalance; critical operations should calibrate threshold to 0.30.
Does not ingest real-time continuous vibrational time-series (uses scalar rotational speed and torque aggregations).
Requires periodic recalibration when tool metallurgy or cutting lubricants change.

deployment_notes.framework: FastAPI REST Service + React Single Page Application (Vite)
deployment_notes.latency: < 25ms per inference request, < 250ms per dynamic SHAP explanation
deployment_notes.monitoring: Telemetry drift tracking recommended on sensor distribution means

maintenance_recommendations: Prescriptive rule engine automatically maps top Shapley attribution drivers (Torque -> mechanical load reduction; Tool wear -> cutting insert replacement; Temperature -> heat exchanger inspection; Rotational speed -> spindle bearing alignment).
ethical_considerations: Designed strictly as decision-support for maintenance crews. Automated alerting must provide explainability rationale to avoid operator fatigue or biased maintenance prioritization.
